data.name: Midland ER310 emergency radio
data.summary: An AM/FM emergency radio with rechargeable, AA, hand-crank and supplementary solar power options. Canadian Weatheradio coverage is no longer available.
data.description: Keep the ER310 on the shortlist for listening to available local AM/FM broadcasts during an outage. Weather-band hardware and a working alert service are different things. Canada has discontinued Weatheradio, so a Canadian household should build its information plan around currently available services instead of assuming this radio will receive local weather alerts.

specs.label: Broadcast bands
specs.value: AM, FM and seven weather channels

specs.label: Charging options
specs.value: Micro-USB input, hand crank and built-in solar panel

specs.label: Battery options
specs.value: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery or six AA cells; AA cells are not recharged by the unit

specs.label: Solar limitation
specs.value: Midland says solar is supplementary and will not recharge a depleted battery by itself

pros: AM/FM reception does not require a phone data connection.
AA backup and USB charging offer alternatives to the internal battery.
cons: Canadian Weatheradio is no longer operating.
Hand-crank and solar charging are not substitutes for routine USB recharging.
The documented battery capacities differ and are not assigned to the supplied radio; no runtime or delivered capacity is guaranteed.
useCases: Listen to available local AM/FM outage updates.
Include radio charging and spare-cell checks in a household readiness routine.

data.name: S.O.S. Emergency Food Rations — 3600 Calories
data.summary: Two packets of ready-to-eat emergency rations sold under the '3600 Calorie' designation. Check the delivered labels, seals and dates; no exact energy total is claimed for the lot.
data.description: The recorded Canadian offer is described as a two-pack. The manufacturer reference label gives nine portions of 84 g and 410 calories per portion. The commercial '3600 Calorie' name and multiplication of rounded serving values do not establish an exact measured energy total for either packet or the lot. Use the delivered ingredients, dates and storage instructions when planning your reserve.

specs.label: Product designation
specs.value: 3600 Calorie / 3600 KCAL is the manufacturer commercial designation, not an independent energy measurement

specs.label: Portions
specs.value: Manufacturer reference label: nine servings of 84 g per packet; match the delivered label

specs.label: Energy inconsistency
specs.value: Reference label: 410 calories per 84 g serving. Rounded serving values and the commercial designation do not establish an exact packet or lot energy total

specs.label: Preparation
specs.value: Ready-to-eat ration in foil packaging

specs.label: Declared storage life
specs.value: Manufacturer five-year design shelf life from manufacture/packaging; check actual manufacture/expiry dates, seals and storage conditions at receipt

specs.label: Allergen reference
specs.value: Manufacturer sheet lists wheat, coconut and soy-related ingredients; check the actual lot

pros: The documented ration can be eaten without heating.
Portioned format supports measured short-term distribution once the actual packet label is checked.
cons: No exact measured energy total is established for the two-pack; do not multiply the commercial designation into a guaranteed lot total.
Serving calories are rounded, and multiplying them differs from the commercial designation.
Contains wheat and other potential allergens; a nut-free facility claim does not mean allergen-free food.
useCases: Compare compact ready-to-eat options for an evacuation bag after checking pack quantity and labels.
Plan a rotated reserve with water and a broader range of suitable foods.

data.name: ReadyWise 84 Servings Gluten-Free Emergency Food Supply Bucket
data.summary: One gluten-free bucket with 84 labelled servings across four recipes. ReadyWise declares 15,420 kcal, corroborated by the inspected yogurt-dessert label version; servings are not complete meals.
data.description: The recorded WGF01-184 listing is for one 84-serving gluten-free bucket, with rice, tortilla soup, a potato entrée and yogurt-style dessert in separate pouches. The manufacturer contents list and inspected back label agree on 15,420 declared kcal when their serving counts are combined. These are rounded label values, not laboratory measurements or a promise that every lot has the same formulation. Plan potable water and preparation equipment, then check the labels, dates and seals of the delivered pouches.

specs.label: Documented assortment
specs.value: One bucket, 13 pouches: 24 Teriyaki Rice, 18 Hearty Tortilla Soup, 18 Potatoes & Chicken Flavored Pot Pie and 24 Creamy Yogurt Style Dessert servings; 84 servings are not 84 complete meals

specs.label: Declared energy
specs.value: 15,420 kcal per reference bucket, declared by ReadyWise and corroborated using the inspected label values; rounded nutrition figures, not independently measured energy

specs.label: Teriyaki Rice
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 270 kcal per 76 g labelled serving

specs.label: Hearty Tortilla Soup
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 160 kcal per 44 g labelled serving

specs.label: Potatoes & Chicken Flavored Pot Pie
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 190 kcal per 47 g labelled serving

specs.label: Creamy Yogurt Style Dessert
specs.value: 8 servings per reference pouch; 110 kcal per 25 g labelled serving

specs.label: Water planning
specs.value: About 63 cups for the reference bucket; use the instructions on the delivered pouches and plan drinking water separately

specs.label: Preparation
specs.value: Reference entrées require heating; the yogurt-style dessert mixes with water. Follow each delivered pouch for water quantity, temperature and preparation time

specs.label: Storage claim
specs.value: Up to 25 years under suitable unopened-pouch storage: cool, dry and protected from moisture, oxygen and light. Check dates and seals; no unconditional lifetime guarantee

pros: Several dish types can complement a broader food reserve.
Sealed pouches allow the contents to be prepared separately.
cons: Requires potable water and a practical preparation/heat plan.
Serving values may be rounded and formulations can differ; 84 servings are not 84 complete meals.
Gluten-free does not mean allergen-free. Check every delivered pouch, dates, seals and storage instructions.
useCases: Plan a household food reserve alongside water, cooking equipment and familiar shelf-stable foods.
Compare labelled portions and calories with household needs instead of counting servings as days or meals.
